title: Suppliers
summary: A company's suppliers: code (generated or typed), party type, tax identity as Coretax needs it (NPWP 16, NIK, passport, PKP), addresses with NITKU, bank accounts (changed only with suppliers.sensitive, every change a security record, a warning when the holder is someone else), contacts, payment days, on hold with a reason — deactivated, never deleted. NIK, passport, and account numbers masked, whole only with an access record. Offers SupplierClient (Get, Search, Usable inside a posting's d.Tx, Snapshot, DefaultBankAccount).
when_to_use: The app buys from known parties: purchase orders, bills, payables, payments, goods receipts.
when_not_to_use: Payables, withholding (PPh 23/4(2)/21/26) and tax certificates (SKB, PP 55/PP 20/2026) — the purchasing, accounting, and tax modules read from this one through their ports.
One supplier list shared by several companies — this module keeps each company's own.

permissions.name: suppliers.manage
permissions.description: Menambah, mengubah, menahan, dan menonaktifkan pemasok

permissions.name: suppliers.sensitive
permissions.description: Melihat NIK, paspor, dan rekening pemasok secara utuh, dan mengubah rekening
